status: CAPACITY PLANNING EXERCISE: every number below is an ASSUMPTION with a low/base/high range, NOT data, NOT a forecast and NOT observed in any kitchen. Its only purpose is to show which station is the bottleneck under plausible ranges and what real ticket-time data to measure first.
units: slot-minutes per plate (one 'slot' is one parallel working position on a station for one minute); a plate = the dish as served (2 tacos, or 1 quesadilla, or 1 chicken-65 board)

comal.note: taco-tortilla-sized positions on a dry comal/plancha

char_tandoor.note: charbroiler/tandoor positions for paneer (or a substitute)

cooks.note: hands-on cook positions for finishing; labour as a capacity

gobi-taco.note: fryer demand applies to the batter-fried arm; low=0 is the roast arm

mix_note: Mix weights are MODEL_ASSUMPTION scenario weights (relative order shares), not predicted guest behavior.
d84_amendment: D-84 (2026-10-15): the dish keyed 'gobi-taco' (legacy id) is now MANGO HABANERO GOBI, an appetizer / shareable with NO tortilla. Its comal range was set to 0 because there is no tortilla to warm; this is an ASSUMPTION, not a measurement, and the fryer/char ranges are carried over unchanged and NOT re-derived (UNVERIFIED). A plate of it is a shareable portion, not 2 tacos.
